recommended.variant: Custom APG non-input combobox with trigger DOM focus and aria-activedescendant on fine pointers; DOM-adjacent top-layer listbox there, inline listbox on coarse pointers, and native select on touch.

entries.behavior: APG keeps DOM focus on the non-input trigger, controls a listbox through aria-activedescendant, and separates active navigation from committed selection; the example explicitly warns about mobile/AT gaps. No ARIA-AT select-only report was found.
entries.source_date: living document; no publication date shown
entries.decision: Use APG active-descendant on fine pointers, DOM-adjacent mounts in both modes, inline on coarse pointers, and native select on touch.

entries.behavior: No measured select-only evidence located for this registry; implemented to the APG contract. No ARIA-AT select-only report was found.
entries.source_date: living document; no publication date shown
entries.decision: Make no NVDA support claim beyond the select-only contract.

entries.behavior: A published editable-combobox result reports no support for conveying aria-haspopup=listbox. It is related evidence, not a select-only test and not an active-descendant failure.
entries.decision: Do not rely on popup-type announcement; expose expanded state, option name, selected state, and position.

entries.behavior: APG 2855 reports inability to navigate into or choose from the expanded select-only listbox. A user reconfirmed on 2025-06-13; latest issue activity was 2025-10-29. The cause was not established.
entries.decision: Use native select on Android; do not ship the custom widget on the observed platform based on desktop evidence.

entries.behavior: WebKit 231724 originally reported missing active-descendant option announcements; a later comment says the original case worked in Safari 18.4/macOS 15.4.1. This is not universal current support.
entries.decision: Verify actual active-option speech in the current real lane and do not claim a fixed version from one comment.

entries.behavior: WebKit 289338 reports VoiceOver skipping a listbox mounted outside the combobox container at the end of body despite aria-controls and active-descendant; the inline comparison works. The report concerns DOM placement, not top-layer promotion itself.
entries.decision: Use native select on iOS; any custom variant must remain DOM-adjacent, with coarse inline fallback and no portal-to-body.
